thread:
Ana (partnerships): Heads up — AcmeCloud PO got rejected by marketplace during invoice ingestion. They split the order into 2 delivery lines (PO# AC-9876-01 / AC-9876-02) and the portal wants a single PO -> invoice mapping. Need urgent help so Acme procurement can pay us this week. Screenshot in ticket: https://acme.example/screenshot

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-04-27-AC-9876 failed validation: multiple related PO numbers found -> action required.

Michael (finance): Is this the same as last quarter where vendor required one invoice per PO? We can accept split invoices but finance needs one master PO number. Can partnerships ask vendor for consolidated PO or can we map an alias?

Tara (legal): I pulled the contract — Section 4.2 ties invoice to PO line items, and the vendor is leaning on delivery SLA wording. We can draft a 1-paragraph carveout allowing consolidated billing for marketplace SKUs.

Joel (marketplace): FYI marketplace changed plumbing last week — they now validate `purchaseOrderId` strictly. Workaround is to add `parentPO` in metadata but marketplace support doesn't consistently honor it. I'll open a support ticket and tag them.

Rachel (ops): Short-term fallback: create a single internal virtual PO that maps both delivery lines in our billing system and emit one invoice. Need Finance approval and partner confirmation. Also must keep tax/jurisdiction correct.

Michael (finance): Virtual PO sounds ok if we keep an auditable ledger of the mapping. But we need vendor sign-off to avoid disputes. Cashflow impact if delayed is material.

Tara (legal): I can draft the amendment. Need vendor contact and procurement note confirming they'll accept consolidated invoices once amendment in place.

Ana (partnerships): @Michael (finance) @Tara (legal) sending vendor contact now — procurement says Acme can accept a single invoice if we list both delivery POs in the invoice description. Will that bypass the portal validation? :thinking_face:

Joel (marketplace): If portal validation blocks, invoice will still be rejected even if vendor accepts it offline. Opened ticket MP-8891 with marketplace-integration-team, cc'd support rep.

invoice-bot: Ticket MP-8891 created and assigned to marketplace-integration-team. ETA 48h.

Rachel (ops): If ticket takes >24h my fallback is to submit two invoices and run a PO-reconciliation entry to mark them as one sale once both are paid. That pushes DSO +7 days.

Michael (finance): Prefer the amendment route — authorize Tara to proceed. Cashflow at risk (~$120k) if we miss this week.

Ana (partnerships): Ok — coordinating a quick sync with procurement + Acme + marketplace support. Tentative call today 4pm PT. @Joel (marketplace) can you join? @Rachel (ops) prepare a billing test (sandbox) so we can exercise both flows before the call.

Joel (marketplace): On it, will be on the call.

Tara (legal): I'll join with a draft amendment and highlight the exact clause to redline.

invoice-bot: Reminder: 4pm PT sync created — calendar invite sent to participants (MP-8891).

Ana (partnerships): Thanks everyone — will update thread after call.
